question_text:
Which sentence demonstrates correct subject-verb agreement with a collective noun?

A) The committee have decided to postpone the hearing until next week.
B) The committee has decided to postpone the hearing until next week.
C) The committee are deciding to postpone the hearing until next week.
D) The committee were deciding to postpone the hearing until next week.

options.text: The committee have decided to postpone the hearing until next week.
The committee has decided to postpone the hearing until next week.
The committee are deciding to postpone the hearing until next week.
The committee were deciding to postpone the hearing until next week.
